passages.p1: Read the email from Oli to his teacher. Choose the correct word for each gap. The first one is done for you. Dear Mr Green, At the weekend I went [[1]] in the forest. I took my new [[2]] to look closely. I saw a small brown bird in a [[3]]. It began to [[4]] a beautiful song. Then it opened its [[5]] and flew away. It was a really [[6]] and peaceful morning.
passages.p2: Put the sentences in the correct order. The first sentence is fixed.
passages.p3:
A. Across much of the world, people are living longer than ever before, and birth rates are falling at the same time. The combined effect is that the average age of many societies is steadily rising. In some countries, those over sixty-five already outnumber young children. This quiet but profound shift is reshaping nations from the ground up.

B. The reasons behind this change are, in many ways, a story of success. Better medicine, cleaner water and improved diets have pushed life expectancy upwards across the globe. Meanwhile, as more women gain education and careers, families have tended to grow smaller. Living longer and having fewer children are both signs of progress, even as they create new challenges.

C. Those challenges weigh heavily on public finances. With more retired people and proportionally fewer workers, the cost of pensions and healthcare rises sharply. A shrinking workforce must somehow support a growing number of dependants. Governments are anxiously searching for ways to keep their systems affordable.

D. Healthcare systems face particular strain as the population ages. Older people are more likely to live with long-term conditions that require ongoing care rather than a single cure. Demand for nurses, carers and suitable housing is climbing steadily. Meeting these needs without exhausting budgets is one of the great tests of our time.

E. Yet an older society is not merely a burden to be managed. Many people now stay active, healthy and productive well into their later years. Retired citizens often volunteer, care for grandchildren and pass on hard-won skills and wisdom. Their experience is a resource that younger generations would be foolish to waste.

F. Countries are experimenting with a range of responses to the trend. Some encourage people to work for longer by raising the retirement age, while others welcome migrants to refill the workforce. A few are investing in technology and robotics to support care for the elderly. There is no single solution, and each approach brings its own difficulties.

G. Ultimately, an ageing world calls for a change in attitudes as much as in policy. Societies that view older people as valued contributors, rather than as a problem, will adapt far more smoothly. Designing communities, workplaces and services for all ages benefits everyone in the end. The task is to grow older together, wisely and with dignity.

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If it _____ sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the park.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Câu điều kiện loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn, will + V
2. Mệnh đề if → dùng hiện tại đơn (không dùng "will")
3. Đáp án: {is} — first conditional
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu ngày mai trời nắng, chúng ta sẽ đi công viên.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If you _____ to call the helpline again, please quote your reference number to expedite the process.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Nhận diện "If you _____" cho thấy đây là câu điều kiện loại 1. 
2. Quy tắc: Câu điều kiện loại 1 dùng thì hiện tại đơn cho mệnh đề if. 
3. Đáp án: {happen} — Câu điều kiện loại 1 dùng thì hiện tại đơn. 
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu bạn "xảy ra" gọi lại đường dây trợ giúp, vui lòng cung cấp số tham chiếu của bạn để đẩy nhanh quá trình. [/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If I _____ you, I would apologise.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Câu điều kiện loại 2: If + past simple, would + V
2. Với "be": dùng "were" cho tất cả ngôi (văn chuẩn)
3. Đáp án: {were} — second conditional
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu tôi là bạn, tôi sẽ xin lỗi.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If you heat water to 100°C, it _____.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Sự thật khoa học → câu điều kiện loại 0
2. Loại 0: If + present simple, present simple
3. Đáp án: {boils} — zero conditional (sự thật)
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu bạn đun nước đến 100°C, nó sẽ sôi.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If I _____ you, I wouldn't be signing that contract without thorough legal advice.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Nhận diện "If I _____ you" là câu điều kiện loại 2.
2. Quy tắc: Dùng "were" cho tất cả chủ ngữ trong câu điều kiện loại 2.
3. Đáp án: {were} — Câu điều kiện loại 2 dùng "were" cho mọi chủ ngữ.
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu tôi là bạn, tôi sẽ không ký hợp đồng đó mà không có lời khuyên pháp lý kỹ lưỡng.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

She won't pass the exam _____ she studies harder.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Nghĩa: không đỗ nếu KHÔNG học chăm hơn
2. "unless" = if… not (trừ khi)
3. Đáp án: {unless} — trừ khi
[/tuduy]
[td]Cô ấy sẽ không đỗ thi trừ khi cô ấy học chăm hơn.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If she _____ harder, she will pass the test.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "will pass" → câu điều kiện loại 1
2. If + present simple (ngôi 3 → studies)
3. Đáp án: {studies} — first conditional
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu cô ấy học chăm hơn, cô ấy sẽ đỗ.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

I would buy that jacket if it _____ cheaper.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "would buy" → câu điều kiện loại 2 (giả định)
2. If + past simple → "were" (hoặc "was" thân mật)
3. Đáp án: {were} — second conditional
[/tuduy]
[td]Tôi sẽ mua cái áo khoác đó nếu nó rẻ hơn.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If I had more time, I _____ learn to play the guitar.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "If I had" → điều kiện loại 2 (giả định không thật ở hiện tại)
2. Mệnh đề chính: would + V nguyên mẫu
3. Đáp án: {would} — second conditional
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu tôi có nhiều thời gian hơn, tôi sẽ học chơi guitar.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

_____ to encounter a venomous snake on the trail, what would your first instinct be?
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Nhận diện "what would your first instinct be?" là câu điều kiện loại 2.
2. Quy tắc: Dùng "were you" cho tình huống giả định không có thật.
3. Đáp án: {Were you} — Dùng "were" cho câu điều kiện loại 2.
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu bạn "gặp phải một con rắn độc trên đường mòn", bản năng đầu tiên của bạn sẽ là gì?[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

I wish I _____ a car. The bus is so slow.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "I wish" + mong muốn trái ngược hiện tại → quá khứ đơn
2. "I wish I had…" = ước gì tôi có (nhưng không có)
3. Đáp án: {had} — wish + past simple
[/tuduy]
[td]Ước gì tôi có xe hơi. Xe buýt chậm quá.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

_____ flooding, residents are advised to move to the upper floors of the building immediately.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Nhận diện cụm từ "_____ flooding" cần điền từ chỉ tình huống.
2. Quy tắc sử dụng "In case of" để chỉ tình huống xảy ra.
3. Đáp án: {In case of} — dùng để chỉ tình huống xảy ra trước khi hành động.
[/tuduy]
[td]Trong trường hợp xảy ra lũ lụt, cư dân được khuyên nên di chuyển lên các tầng trên của tòa nhà ngay lập tức.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If you _____ early, you can get a good seat.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Lời khuyên thực tế → câu điều kiện loại 1
2. If + present simple, can/will + V
3. Đáp án: {arrive} — first conditional
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu bạn đến sớm, bạn có thể có chỗ ngồi tốt.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If he _____ rich, he would travel the world.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "would travel" → điều kiện loại 2 (giả định)
2. Với "be" trong if-clause loại 2 → dùng "were"
3. Đáp án: {were} — second conditional
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu anh ấy giàu, anh ấy sẽ đi du lịch vòng quanh thế giới.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If you don't water the plants, they _____.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Sự thật chung → câu điều kiện loại 0
2. Loại 0: If + present simple, present simple
3. Đáp án: {die} — zero conditional
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu bạn không tưới cây, chúng sẽ chết.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

You can borrow my flat in Vienna _____ you water the plants and feed the cat.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Nhận diện cụm từ "_____ you water the plants and feed the cat" yêu cầu điều kiện.
2. Quy tắc: "as long as" diễn tả điều kiện cần thiết để một việc xảy ra.
3. Đáp án: {as long as} — dùng để chỉ điều kiện cần thiết cho hành động xảy ra.
[/tuduy]
[td]Bạn có thể mượn căn hộ của tôi ở Vienna miễn là bạn tưới cây và cho mèo ăn.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

What _____ you do if you found a wallet on the street?
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "if you found" → điều kiện loại 2 (giả định)
2. Mệnh đề chính: would + V
3. Đáp án: {would} — second conditional
[/tuduy]
[td]Bạn sẽ làm gì nếu nhặt được ví trên đường?[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

_____ the prime minister to resign tomorrow, the markets would be thrown into turmoil.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Nhận diện dấu hiệu ngữ pháp: câu điều kiện loại 2 với "were".
2. Quy tắc: Dùng "were" cho giả định không có thật ở hiện tại.
3. Đáp án: {Were} — dùng "were" cho câu điều kiện loại 2.
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu "thủ tướng" từ chức vào ngày mai, các thị trường sẽ rơi vào hỗn loạn.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

We'll go out _____ it stops raining.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Chắc chắn mưa sẽ tạnh → dùng "when" (khi)
2. "if" = nếu (không chắc); "when" = khi (chắc chắn)
3. Đáp án: {when} — khi (chắc chắn xảy ra)
[/tuduy]
[td]Chúng ta sẽ ra ngoài khi trời tạnh mưa.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

Take an umbrella _____ it rains later.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Mang ô PHÒNG KHI trời mưa (chuẩn bị trước)
2. "in case" = phòng khi (đề phòng); "if" = nếu (phản ứng lại)
3. Đáp án: {in case} — phòng khi
[/tuduy]
[td]Mang theo ô phòng khi lát nữa trời mưa.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If I _____ the answer, I would tell you.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "would tell" → điều kiện loại 2
2. If + past simple → "knew"
3. Đáp án: {knew} — second conditional
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu tôi biết câu trả lời, tôi sẽ nói cho bạn.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

You'll miss the bus _____ you leave now.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Nghĩa: sẽ lỡ xe buýt nếu KHÔNG đi ngay
2. "unless" = if… not (trừ khi)
3. Đáp án: {unless} — trừ khi đi ngay
[/tuduy]
[td]Bạn sẽ lỡ xe buýt trừ khi bạn đi ngay bây giờ.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If the lifeguard _____ on duty that afternoon, the swimmer would almost certainly have drowned.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. Nhận diện dấu hiệu "If" chỉ điều kiện trong câu.
2. Quy tắc: Câu điều kiện loại 3 dùng "hadn't been" cho tình huống không xảy ra trong quá khứ.
3. Đáp án: {hadn't been} — Câu điều kiện loại 3 diễn tả điều không có thật trong quá khứ.
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu nhân viên cứu hộ "không có mặt" chiều hôm đó, thì vận động viên bơi gần như chắc chắn đã chết đuối. [/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If we _____ a bigger house, we could have a dog.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "could have" → điều kiện loại 2 (giả định)
2. If + past simple → "had"
3. Đáp án: {had} — second conditional
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu chúng ta có nhà lớn hơn, chúng ta có thể nuôi chó.[/td]

questions.content:
Grammar and Vocabulary — Grammar

If you _____ me, I'll help you with your homework.
questions.explanation:
[tuduy]
1. "I'll help" → câu điều kiện loại 1
2. If + present simple, will + V
3. Đáp án: {ask} — first conditional
[/tuduy]
[td]Nếu bạn nhờ tôi, tôi sẽ giúp bạn làm bài tập.[/td]

questions.content:
Writing — Part 2 - Short text

You are a new member of a travel group. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Do you usually travel by car?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I usually travel by car every day. I drive to my office in the city centre because the bus is often very slow and crowded. I really enjoy listening to my favourite music while I am driving in the morning.

questions.content:
Writing — Part 3 - Three responses

Kwame: I live in a tall building and usually walk downstairs to exercise. How do you usually exercise?
questions.sampleAnswer: I usually exercise by cycling around my local park. Three times a week, I ride for about an hour after work. I find it relaxing, and it helps me stay fit while enjoying the fresh air.

questions.content:
Writing — Part 3 - Three responses

Sofia: I usually get up early to run in the morning because I feel tired in the evening. What about you?
questions.sampleAnswer: I am quite different from you. I prefer exercising in the evening because mornings feel too rushed. After dinner, I go for a long walk, which helps me relax and sleep much better at night.

questions.content:
Writing — Part 3 - Three responses

Noah: Nowadays technology makes life easier, but it also makes people lazy and dislike exercise. Do you agree?
questions.sampleAnswer: I partly agree with you. Technology can make people lazy because we sit and use screens for hours. However, it also offers fitness apps and online classes, which actually encourage many people to exercise more regularly.

questions.content:
Writing — Part 4 - Informal and formal emails

Write an email to your friend. Write about your feelings and what you would suggest. Write about 50 words. Recommended time: 10 minutes.
questions.sampleAnswer:
Hi Leo!
Our Global Screen Club is hosting an event for international guests and needs venue ideas! I think the convention centre near the train station would be perfect — easy to find and lots of space. For the programme, a world cinema showcase with subtitled films from different countries would be amazing!
Exciting stuff,
Tara

questions.content:
Writing — Part 4 - Informal and formal emails

Write an email to the events team. Write about your suggestions for the venue and programme. Write 120–150 words. Recommended time: 20 minutes.
questions.sampleAnswer:
Dear Events Team,
I am writing to share my suggestions for the upcoming international screening event. I believe the right venue and a carefully planned programme could make this a truly memorable occasion.
For the venue, I would recommend the City Convention Centre near the central train station. It is well-connected by public transport and easy for visitors from abroad to locate. The centre also has a large screening hall with modern audio-visual equipment and multilingual signage.
Regarding the programme, I suggest a world cinema showcase featuring short films from at least five different countries, each with English subtitles. After the screenings, a panel discussion with the filmmakers — conducted in English — would allow guests to share perspectives and connect across cultures.
To add a social element, a reception with food and drinks from various cuisines would create a welcoming, international atmosphere.
I hope these ideas are helpful.
Yours sincerely,
Patrick Brennan

Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

Which season do you like best?

Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

Tell me about a book you enjoyed.
questions.sampleAnswer: I enjoyed a book called "The Little Prince". It is a short story about a boy from another planet. It teaches us about love and friendship. I read it many times because it is very meaningful.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

What are you going to do tonight?
questions.sampleAnswer: Tonight I am going to stay home and relax. I will have dinner with my family. After that, I will watch a movie and read a little. Then I will go to bed early.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Describe the picture.
questions.sampleAnswer: I see three elderly people sitting and talking together. They look happy and relaxed. Maybe they are old friends. They are smiling and enjoying their conversation in a park or garden.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Do you enjoy spending time with elderly people? Why?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I enjoy spending time with elderly people. They tell interesting stories about the past. I learn many things from them. My grandparents are very wise and kind. I love listening to them.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Why is it important for older people to stay socially active?
questions.sampleAnswer: It is important for old people to stay social because it makes them happy. If they are alone, they can feel sad and lonely. Talking with friends keeps their mind active. Social activities are good for their health and they live longer.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Describe the two pictures.
questions.sampleAnswer: In the first picture, I see a person reading a book to relax. They are sitting comfortably and look peaceful. It is quiet around them. In the second picture, I see a person gardening. They are planting flowers and taking care of plants. They are outside in a garden and look happy.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

What are the benefits of these two ways of relaxing?
questions.sampleAnswer: Reading is relaxing and good for the brain. You can learn new things and use your imagination. But you sit all the time. Gardening is good exercise and you are outside in fresh air. But it is tiring and you can get dirty.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Which do you prefer, and why?
questions.sampleAnswer: I prefer reading because it is quiet and relaxing. I can read anywhere, even in bed. But I think gardening is also nice because you get fresh air and exercise. Sometimes I do both.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 4 - Discuss an abstract topic

Tell me about a time when you visited someone.
questions.sampleAnswer:
Last month, I visited my grandmother in the countryside. She lives far away so I don't see her often. I took a bus for three hours to get to her house. I was very happy to see her.
I visited her because I missed her and wanted to spend time with her. She is old and lives alone. I helped her with housework and we cooked together. We talked a lot and she told me stories about the past.
Yes, I think visiting people in person is very important. When you visit someone, you show that you care about them. Talking on the phone is not the same as meeting in person. Visiting makes relationships stronger and makes people happy.
